rules.title: Not color alone
rules.rule: Status and meaning are never carried by color alone; pair with an icon, text or underline.

rules.title: Alt by purpose
rules.rule: Alt text says what the image communicates or does; decorative images use alt="".
rules.notes: Text-only judge over extracted alt strings.

rules.title: Separators last
rules.rule: Use a separator only where space cannot carry structure, as a low-contrast hairline, never beside a large gap that already did the job.

rules.title: Static is not control-shaped
rules.rule: A non-clickable badge never looks exactly like the buttons beside it.

rules.title: RTL mirror
rules.rule: Under dir=rtl the layout mirrors cleanly, progression included.
rules.notes: Only when the app supports RTL.

rules.title: Importance order
rules.rule: The most important content sits top and leading; identity leads, metadata and actions trail.

rules.title: Content bleeds, controls stay inside
rules.rule: Backgrounds and media may bleed to the edges; controls and text stay inside layout margins.

rules.title: No text images
rules.rule: Decorative text is CSS, not images.

rules.title: Pair fonts for contrast
rules.rule: Pair fonts for contrast, never two near-identical sans-serifs.

rules.title: Semantic color keeps its meaning
rules.rule: A semantic color is never used against its meaning.

rules.title: No hue detours
rules.rule: oklch gradients show no intermediate hues you never defined.

rules.title: Optical glyph alignment
rules.rule: Asymmetric icons (play, star) are aligned optically, preferably fixed in the SVG.

rules.title: Shadows for depth
rules.rule: A border that only creates depth (cards over images or colored backgrounds) becomes a layered transparent shadow; structural, input, divider and selected borders stay.
rules.notes: The DS draws frames with hairline borders, so the DS wins; this applies only where a border fights an image or colored backdrop.

rules.title: Images match the UI
rules.rule: Outline avatars when neighbouring controls have borders, not when they don't.

rules.title: Outline default, fill active
rules.rule: Outline is the default icon variant; fill marks the active state only.

rules.title: Subtle focus motion
rules.rule: Focus animations stay subtle; no complex motion during keyboard navigation.

rules.title: Not over-animated
rules.rule: Feedback animation stays subtle; no stacking of several effects on one interaction.

rules.title: Low cognitive load
rules.rule: Screens are simple and predictable.

rules.title: Consistent terms
rules.rule: Each object and action has one name across the product.

rules.title: Tone by stakes
rules.rule: Tone flexes with stakes: warm for success, neutral for routine, calm for errors, serious for data loss.

rules.title: Plain words
rules.rule: Plain words a tired reader gets on first pass; no idioms; match the device verb (click on desktop).

rules.title: Requirements up front
rules.rule: Known requirements show as helper text before input, phrased positively.

rules.title: Parallel status copy
rules.rule: Status copy follows patterns: '-ing + object…' in progress, 'object + past tense' when done.

rules.title: Content shape
rules.rule: User text survives emoji, RTL, mixed direction, tall scripts and aligned numbers.

rules.title: Rounding threshold
rules.rule: Rounding a design value to a token is fine up to 2px on size and within one color step; beyond that is a deviation.

rules.title: Fidelity compare
rules.rule: A build is compared side by side with its design at every frame width before it is done.

rules.title: Sibling parity
rules.rule: A control added to one surface is added to siblings that carry its peers.

rules.title: Diff scope
rules.rule: A design build touches only what the frames show.

rules.title: Variant floor
rules.rule: Every candidate design clears the escalation floor before it is shown.
rules.notes: Process rule for design variants, not a page property.

rules.title: Evidence tiers
rules.rule: Every claimed value is tagged measured, derived or inferred.
rules.notes: Applies to the verifier's own reports.

rules.title: Dogfood the flow
rules.rule: Use what you build end to end before calling it done.

rules.title: Justify each addition
rules.rule: Add an element, animation or feature only when it clearly improves the result.
